articles.title: VentureBeat lead analyst Rob Strechay, left, speaking at VB Transform in July
articles.author: Matt Marshall
articles.content: VentureBeat lead analyst Rob Strechay, left, speaking at VB Transform in July Rob Strechay, until recently managing director and principal analyst at theCUBE Research, has joined VentureBeat as our first Lead Analyst and a founding analyst of VentureBeat Research. His arrival is the next step in a deliberate move at VentureBeat toward deeper specialization: analysis built for the technical decision-makers — the directors, VPs, CIOs, and CTOs — who are evaluating, buying, and deploying enterprise AI.
headings: VentureBeat names Rob Strechay as its first Lead Analyst, expanding its enterprise AI research push
